Reports.description: 查看學生進度和教室分析

description.A0: 您可以识别您以前见过的单词和名称，尤其是在有图片帮助的情况下。您可以理解您周围的真实简单的标志和基本信息，如在哪里和什么时候发生什么事情。
description.A1-: 您开始识别更多的单词和简单的短语，超越了最基本的词汇。您可以遵循短、简单的方向，并理解基本的短语和句子，关于您需要的事情。
description.A1: 您可以理解非常短和简单的文本。您可以识别足够的单词来发现它们在通知和简单指南中的位置。您可以使用您知道的单词谈论简单、日常的事情。
description.A1+: 您开始理解对您重要的句子表达。阅读不仅仅是识别熟悉的单词；您开始理解简单的文本中的整个信息。
description.A2-: 您在理解简单文本方面做得更好，可以在日常材料中找到特定信息，如广告或时间表，尽管您可能仍然对不熟悉的主题感到困惑。
description.A2: 您可以理解短、简单的文本，在日常材料中找到您需要的信息，如广告或菜单，并遵循基本指令。您知道足够的单词来在日常情况下沟通。
description.A2+: 您可以理解常规写作和短新闻故事或描述的主要观点。您的词汇量在增长，因此您可以谈论对您重要的事情，并处理日常情况。
description.B1-: 您可以理解熟悉主题的直接文本的主要观点。您正在发展处理介绍新主题或稍微更复杂语言的文本的能力，尽管您可能仍然需要一些帮助。
description.B1: 您可以阅读您喜欢的主题的文本，并理解主要观点。故事和个人信息对您来说很容易理解。您知道足够的单词用于日常主题，并且可以谈论您阅读的内容，不会遇到太多困难。
description.B1+: 您可以理解关于熟悉主题的清晰写作，并且处理稍微更复杂的语言的能力有所提高。您可以轻松找到您需要的信息，并且可以享受一本不太困难的书籍。
description.B2-: 您可以理解关于熟悉主题的详细文本。您开始识别语言的微妙部分，并且可以轻松讨论您感兴趣的主题，尽管非常复杂的想法可能仍然具有挑战性。
description.B2: 您可以独立阅读并判断文本是正式还是非正式。您可以根据您正在阅读的内容调整阅读速度。您喜欢关于当前事件的好书和文章。您知道很多单词，即使有时您会感到困惑，您通常也能弄清楚。
description.B2+: 您可以理解更具挑战性文本的主要观点，如科学文章或更复杂的故事。您开始更多地独立阅读，并且可以处理抽象或技术性主题，特别是您熟悉的主题。
description.C1-: 您可以通过一些努力理解复杂文本。您的词汇量使您可以阅读许多不同的主题，并且您可以弄清楚不太明显的细节，尽管有时您可能需要重新阅读某些部分。
description.C1: 您可以阅读长而具有挑战性的文本并理解大部分发生的事情。您喜欢让您思考的故事和文章，并且可以使用良好的词汇谈论它们，而无需太费力地查找正确的单词。
description.C1+: 您是一个超级读者，可以处理具有挑战性的文本并理解不同的写作风格。您非常擅长弄清楚故事和文章中不太明显的部分，并且通常知道单词的意思，而无需查找它们。
description.C2: 您可以阅读和理解几乎任何事情。您可以理解复杂文本的主要观点，并且喜欢阅读更具挑战性的书籍和文章。您可以谈论几乎任何事情，并且使用语言充满信心。
description.A0-: 你剛開始學英文。你認得一些字母和幾個單字，尤其是有圖片的單字。
description.A0+: 你認得更多簡單的單字和名字。你看得懂有圖片的很短詞句，例如標誌和標籤。

pitch.rpg-battle: 選出正確的詞義，打敗哥布林王。
pitch.rune-match: 把每個單字和它的符文配成一對。
pitch.dragon-rider: 用正確的單字飛過大門。
pitch.enchanted-library: 接住正確的書，躲開錯誤的書。
pitch.castle-defense: 把單字排成正確的順序，守住城牆。
pitch.potion-rush: 在藥水煮沸之前拼好句子。
pitch.abyssal-well: 按照句子中單字的順序，射擊從井裡爬出來的怪物。
pitch.alchemists-synthesis: 讀配方卡上的詞義，選出寫著對應單字的瓶子，倒進大鍋裡。
pitch.archers-revenge: 讀詞義，然後射擊盾牌上寫著正確單字的敵人。
pitch.astral-mage: 按照句子中單字的順序向單字水晶發射魔法彈，用星星組成每個咒語。
pitch.devourer-slime: 按順序吃掉每個句子的單字泡泡；每吃對一個單字就長大一點，然後吞掉守衛。
pitch.dragon-flight: 騎著火龍飛過詞義正確的大門：每過一扇正確的門，龍群就多一條龍，一起對付頭目。
pitch.dungeon-liberator: 按照句子中單字的順序救出沉沒地窖裡的村民，再帶著隊伍從大門出去。
pitch.griffin-riders-escape: 駕駛獅鷲飛過寫著句子下一個單字的大門，繞開蝙蝠群，完成整個句子。
pitch.griffin-sky-joust: 騎著獅鷲飛行，按順序從上方攻擊拿著句子下一個單字的騎士。
pitch.gryphon-patrol: 騎著獅鷲飛過森林，射擊拿著句子下一個單字的蝙蝠並拿走這個單字，完成整個句子。
pitch.haunted-library: 爬上舊圖書館的四層樓，按照句子中單字的順序打開門，躲開幽靈和蝙蝠。
pitch.hero-vs-zombie: 跑向寫著你的單字詞義的光球，為衝擊波充能，在天亮前打倒墓地裡的殭屍。
pitch.labyrinth: 走進石頭迷宮，按照句子順序拿到單字光球，躲開哥布林。
pitch.magic-defense: 每顆飛彈上有一個詞義：在它撞上城堡之前，施放正確的英語單字把它打碎。
pitch.paladins-twin-soul: 找到拿著對應單字的幽影，解救聖騎士的雙生靈魂。
pitch.realm-carver: 按順序從荒野中挖出每個句子裡發光的單字，別讓怪物擋住你的路。
pitch.rune-forge-chamber: 按照句子中單字的順序敲擊環繞飛行的單字符文，鍛造每一把劍。
pitch.shadow-gate-dungeon: 按照句子中單字的順序收集單字水晶，跑在黑影前面，然後穿過大門。
pitch.sorcerer-ziggurat: 按照每個句子中單字的順序，一塊一塊踩著符文方塊爬上階梯金字塔，點亮塔頂的水晶。
pitch.spellweavers-run: 在魔法之路上奔跑，按順序選出寫著句子下一個單字的發光球，唸完整個句子的咒語。
pitch.storm-castle-tower: 爬上城堡塔樓，按照句子中單字的順序打開單字窗戶，避開落下的熱油和石頭。
pitch.village-guardian: 按照句子中單字的順序呼喚村民，保護他們不被強盜和哥布林抓走，再帶他們進穀倉。

book.body: Each Primary Advantage workbook has 14 lessons. The app has the same lessons, with audio, pictures, and practice. Students read the printed book in class and continue in the app.

inside.title: Inside the app
inside.intro: Every page of the app is a place in Chibi Quest, a picture-book game world. The story page stays plain, so the reading comes first.

hero.title: Choose a hero
hero.body: Each student chooses a hero, then picks its skin, hair, eye, and clothes colors.
hero.alt: The hero shrine on desktop: the hero classes stand on stones, each with a name sign

shop.title: Earn GP, choose gear
shop.body: Students earn Guild Points (GP) when they read and practice. They spend GP on gear for their hero in the shop. GP cannot be bought with money.
shop.alt: The avatar shop on a phone: gear with GP prices, and the bracers marked "Owned" after the student buys them

quest.title: Class Quest: one boss, the whole class
quest.body: During the week, students meet reading goals to earn power-ups. Then the whole class fights one boss together on the classroom projector. There is no leaderboard and no ranking.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Reading Advantage (Thailand) is a curriculum publisher in Khon Kaen. Phikul Phookathin and Daniel Bo started the company in January 2024. We make printed English workbooks and matching apps for Thai schools and families.

product.title: What Primary Advantage is
product.body: Primary Advantage is English reading for grades 3–6 (ages 8–11). Each workbook has 14 lessons with stories and informational texts, new words, questions, and writing, and the app has the same lessons. Every article, question, and word is being tagged to Mastery Advantage, our map of English skills. The method is extensive reading. Research shows extensive reading outperforms traditional grammar instruction (Aka, 2019).

schools.title: For schools: Blended Learning
schools.body: Schools use Primary Advantage through Blended Learning: printed workbooks and the app, with teacher training and step-by-step lesson plans. The lesson plans assume the teacher is a fluent Thai speaker, not a native English teacher.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Teachers sign in with an e-mail address and a password. The Google button is gone.
signin.step2: Press the <ui>{teacherTab}</ui> tab. The sign-in page always opens on the <ui>{studentTab}</ui> tab.
signin.step3: In the <ui>{username}</ui> field, type your e-mail address. In the <ui>{password}</ui> field, type your password. Then press <ui>{signIn}</ui>.
signin.oldSystem: Teachers from the old system: the screen says “{staffHelp}”
signin.step4: Use the temporary password from the school. The app shows the page <ui>{setNewPassword}</ui>.
signin.step5: Type a new password in <ui>{newPassword}</ui>. Type it again in <ui>{confirmPassword}</ui>. Then press <ui>{saveAndSignIn}</ui>.
signin.rule: The new password has 8 characters or more and is not the temporary password. After this, the temporary password stops working.
signin.forgot: Forgot the password: ask the school's administrator for a new password.

class.title: Find your class
class.lead: After sign-in, the app opens the teacher's <ui>{home}</ui>.
class.step1: In the menu at the left, press <ui>{myClasses}</ui>.
class.step2: Press the class name in the table. The app opens the class page.
class.phone: On a phone: press the menu button ☰ at the top of the screen to open the full menu, with <ui>{manual}</ui>.
class.shortcut: Shortcut: in the class table on the home page, the <ui>{startClassLink}</ui> link opens the class page, but it does not start the class. On the class page, press <ui>{startClass}</ui> again (section 3).

startClass.title: Open the class for student sign-in
startClass.lead: Students sign in with a 6-character code and 3 pictures only while the teacher's class is open.
startClass.step1: On the class page, in the <ui>{classCard}</ui> card, press <ui>{startClass}</ui>.
startClass.step2: Write the 6-character code under <ui>{classCode}</ui> on the board. The code shows only once. The student screen calls this code <ui>{studentCode}</ui>.
startClass.step3: The students sign in with the “Student sign-in” sheet. The teacher sees the count at <ui>{signedInCount}</ui>.
startClass.step4: At the end of the period, press <ui>{endClass}</ui>. The class also closes by itself after 3 hours.
startClass.newCode: To see a code again, press <ui>{newCode}</ui>. The app shows a new code, and the old code stops working.
startClass.pictureSetting: You can turn off <ui>{pictureSetting}</ui>. Then students sign in with the code and the name only. Some features, such as Reedy, need a full sign-in.
startClass.help1: 5 wrong taps: the app locks that student for 5 minutes. Wait, then try again.
startClass.help2: Forgot the pictures: in the <ui>{students}</ui> list, press <ui>{resetPictures}</ui> on that student's row, and show the new pictures to the student at once, because they show only once. This button asks no question, and it signs that student out.
startClass.help3: No pictures yet: press <ui>{setPictures}</ui> on that student's row.

assignBook.title: Assign the book to the class (once)
assignBook.lead: Do this once for each class, before the first lesson.
assignBook.step1: On the class page, go down to the book part. A new class shows the text “{noBook}”.
assignBook.step2: At <ui>{book}</ui>, choose the book of the class.
assignBook.step4: At <ui>{startDate}</ui>, choose the day of the first lesson. Then press <ui>{assignBook}</ui>. The app shows “{bookAssigned}”.
assignBook.modeNote: <ui>{teacherLed}</ui>: a student opens an app step only after the teacher marks that workbook step (4.2). <ui>{independent}</ui>: the student opens every step.
assignBook.emptyNote: No book in the list: the screen shows “{emptyCatalogue}”. Contact us (top of this page).

lesson.title: Teach the lesson
lesson.lead: The teacher teaches from the workbook and presses in the app one step at a time. The app opens the same step for the students.
lesson.step1: On the class page, in the <ui>{nowInClass}</ui> card, press <ui>{openLesson}</ui>. The card shows the current lesson and the <ui>{nextStep}</ui>.
lesson.step2: The <ui>{live}</ui> box on the lesson page shows the first step that the class has not done: the teacher actions, the teacher's words, and a <ui>{tip}</ui>. Below it, the 13-step guide shows all steps with <ui>{teacherActions}</ui>, <ui>{teacherLanguage}</ui>, <ui>{studentActions}</ui>, <ui>{watchFor}</ui>, and <ui>{script}</ui>.
lesson.step3: When the class finishes the step in the workbook, press <ui>{markDone}</ui>. The app opens the same step for the students, and the button changes to <ui>{undo}</ui>. Then press <ui>{next}</ui> to go to the next step. A wrong press: press <ui>{undo}</ui>.
lesson.step4: Whole-class reading: press <ui>{projector}</ui>. Click a paragraph to focus it. Press <ui>{showAnswer}</ui> to reveal the answers.
lesson.markAll: Mark every step. A student opens an app step only after the teacher presses <ui>{markDone}</ui>. Until then, the student sees “{lockedText}”.
lesson.steps13: The workbook has 13 steps. The student app has 14 steps. The app matches the steps.

afterLesson.title: After the lesson
afterLesson.step1: On the class page, press <ui>{lessonPlan}</ui>, then <ui>{classProgress}</ui>. The table shows the app steps that each student did, of 14.
afterLesson.step2: Go back to <ui>{lessonPlan}</ui> and press <ui>{markTaught}</ui> on that lesson. This button marks all 13 steps done, so the students can open every app step. If it is the current lesson, the class moves to the next lesson. Press it only after the lesson ends.
afterLesson.buttonsTitle: Useful buttons on the lesson page
afterLesson.rehearsal: <ui>{rehearsal}</ui>: see the lesson as a student sees it. Nothing saves.
afterLesson.print: <ui>{printLesson}</ui>: in the print window, choose A4 and turn off “Headers and footers”.
afterLesson.teachAgain: <ui>{teachAgain}</ui> (in the <ui>{lessonPlan}</ui>): starts the lesson again. Each student's work stays in the history, and the XP stays.

homework.title: Give homework
homework.lead: Homework is one reading story. The teacher chooses a story and gives it to the whole class or to some students.
homework.step1: In the menu, press <ui>{assignments}</ui>, then <ui>{newAssignment}</ui>. The app opens the story list.
homework.step2: Choose a story and open it.
homework.step3: On the story page, press the <ui>{assignButton}</ui> button.
homework.step4: In the <ui>{createAssignment}</ui> window: choose the <ui>{classroom}</ui>, type the <ui>{assignmentName}</ui> and the <ui>{assignmentDescription}</ui>, choose the <ui>{studentsField}</ui> or <ui>{selectAll}</ui>, choose the <ui>{dueDate}</ui>, then press <ui>{submit}</ui>. The app shows “{saved}”.
homework.step5: See the results: in the menu <ui>{assignments}</ui>, choose the class, then press the assignment name to see the progress of each student.
homework.studentsSee: Where students see the homework: on the student home, in the <ui>{todayLesson}</ui> card (the assignment with the nearest due date), and in the menu <ui>{assignments}</ui>, on the page <ui>{myWork}</ui>.
homework.atHome: Homework at home needs the username and password. The code, the pictures, and the QR card work only while the teacher's class is open. At home, students sign in with the username and password from the <ui>{classSheet}</ui> (section 6).

classSheet.title: Class sheet and QR cards: read before you press
classSheet.lead: Both buttons are on the class page, in the <ui>{classCard}</ui> card: <ui>{classSheet}</ui> and <ui>{qrCards}</ui>.
classSheet.versionATitle: If the team gave your class its sheet
classSheet.versionA: The team already gave your class its class sheet. Use that sheet and keep one copy. Press <ui>{makeSheet}</ui> only when the whole sheet is lost.
classSheet.versionBTitle: If your class has no sheet yet
classSheet.versionB: Make the class sheet once, before the first lesson, outside class time. Then print it with the steps below.
classSheet.sheetIntro: The class sheet shows each student's username and password, for sign-in away from the classroom, for example homework at home.
classSheet.warning: When you press <ui>{makeSheet}</ui>: the app sets a new password for every student in this class. Every student is signed out. The old sheet stops working. The new passwords show only once. Make the sheet outside class time, and print it at once.
classSheet.oneStudent: One student forgot the password: use the <ui>{studentNewPassword}</ui> button on that student's row (below).
classSheet.step3: Press <ui>{print}</ui> at once, before you leave the page. Cut the sheet and give each student only the part with the student's name.
classSheet.forgot: In the <ui>{students}</ui> list, press <ui>{studentNewPassword}</ui> on that student's row. In the window <ui>{passwordConfirmTitle}</ui>, press <ui>{passwordConfirm}</ui>. The app sets a new password for that student only, and signs that student out. The other students keep their passwords. The new password shows only once: the student writes it down at once, or you press <ui>{passwordPrint}</ui>.
classSheet.qrTitle: QR cards: read before you press
classSheet.qrLead: One QR card signs one student in with one scan. It works only while the teacher's class is open.
classSheet.step4: Press <ui>{qrCards}</ui>, then <ui>{issueCards}</ui>. The app makes cards only for students without a card.
classSheet.step5: Press <ui>{printCards}</ui> at once: a card shows only once.
classSheet.lostCard: Lost card: in the <ui>{students}</ui> list, press <ui>{newCard}</ui> on that student's row and confirm. The old card stops at once, and that student is signed out. A QR card works only while the teacher's class is open.
